assumptions: Plate is roughly 25-27 cm across; no cutlery or hand in frame for direct scale
Dark sliced meat is beef steak (sirloin-type), pink interior indicates medium-rare
Pale meat at top is roasted chicken breast, not pork or fish
Browned cubes at top right are skin-on roasted potatoes
Cauliflower is steamed/boiled with no visible sauce or butter; any added fat is not counted separately
Cooking oil amount is inferred from browning of potatoes and meats, not directly visible
Green pieces among the cauliflower are cauliflower leaf/stem, counted within the cauliflower mass
